steps.text: Nodeling prepares Hashinal NFT collections with authenticity receipts and multi-collection allowlists. No Hedera account is needed for the offline demo. How others use it: docs/for-others.md (creator · collector · builder) and UI /start. List minted Hashinals on SentX DreamForge / HashPack — this is not a marketplace competitor.

steps.command: npm install && npm run build && npm run demo
steps.label: Install, build, and run the offline demo (GREEN/RED + DROP PASS)
Start the mint pad — open /start first, then /, /verify, /allowlist, /about
Read how others utilize Nodeling
steps.text: docs/for-others.md — day-one checklist + creator / collector / builder paths. Spec: docs/NODELING-HASHINAL.md.

steps.label: Verify a package
steps.text: Paste *-nodeling-receipts.json (or a fixture receipt) on /verify. GREEN = clean; RED = tamper / bad edition / forged allowlist.

steps.label: Copy the env file (optional; live testnet CLI only)
steps.text: packages/nextjs/.env.example → packages/nextjs/.env — never put keys in the browser.
